$comment: The account sheet (app/account/edit.tsx) and an account's own screen (app/accounts/[id].tsx).

nameTitle.note: Title of the text field that names an account.

name.note: Chip that opens the name field while the account has none.

balanceA11y.note: VoiceOver label; amount is formatted with its currency code, "1 200.00 PLN".

openingA11y.note: VoiceOver label; amount is formatted with its currency code.

openingBecomes.message: Opening balance becomes {amount}; transactions are not changed
openingBecomes.note: Under the balance while it is being changed; amount is formatted with its currency code.

openingIs.note: Under the balance of an existing account; amount is formatted with its currency code.

typeToReplace.note: Hint under a prefilled balance: a digit replaces it, backspace edits it.

inNetWorth.note: Chip: the account counts towards net worth.

excluded.note: Same chip when the account is left out of net worth.

current.note: Chip: the account logging defaults to. Not the bank product.

currentHint: Logging defaults to this account and Budgets shows it with its own budgets.

archive.title: Archive account?
archive.body: {count, plural, one {# transaction stays where it is.} other {# transactions stay where they are.}} The account is hidden from logging, Budgets and net worth and shown as disabled under Accounts. You can unarchive it any time.

delete.title: Delete account?
delete.body: It has no transactions, so nothing else is removed.

edit.note: VoiceOver label of the header button.

afterPlanned.note: Followed by the balance once planned and pending entries are counted.

chip.note: Chip on the account sheet: the last four digits the bank prints for this account.

title.message: Last 4 digits, as the bank prints them
title.note: Placeholder of the text field for the account's numbers; several may be separated by commas.
